name: tshtml-monorepo
description: TypeScript HTML template engine with webpack loader support

scripts.build: npm run build -w tshtml && npm run build -w tshtml-loader
scripts.test: npm run test -w tshtml && npm run test -w tshtml-loader
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage -w tshtml && npm run coverage -w tshtml-loader
scripts.clean: rimraf tshtml/dist tshtml-loader/dist tshtml/coverage tshtml-loader/coverage .nyc_output coverage dist
scripts.link: cd tshtml && npm link && cd ../tshtml-loader && npm link tshtml && npm link && cd ..
scripts.unlink: cd tshtml && npm unlink --global && cd ../tshtml-loader && npm unlink --global && cd ..
scripts.pack: npm run build && rimraf dist && mkdir dist && cd tshtml && npm pack && move tshtml-*.tgz ../dist && cd ../tshtml-loader && npm pack && move tshtml-loader-*.tgz ../dist && cd ..

author: LOGEX Group
